race.comment: THE UNDERQUOTER (11) resumes having run in a very strong 2yo race on debut at Randwick Kensington, solid enough there behind subsequent G1 winner Tron Bolt. Since spelled and should be an improver second preparation. HIERARCHY (9) ran a good race on debut at Mornington when in the market, sent out $2.90 and running on strongly for third. He's a beautifully bred colt by Dubawi out of G1 winner Colette who should relish the extra ground here. PINAZAKI (10) ran well fresh at Seymour, battling on for third. Fitter now and should appreciate a rise in trip. SATOSHI (13) was just fair at Mornington last time but should improve third up.
